dedupe_keys.name: hermess hybrid emt and rms simulator

description: HERMESS is an ETH Zurich-derived Python simulator for nonlinear differential-algebraic power-system models. It is a simulation-only fork of PowerDynamicEstimator, with dynamic state estimation removed. Inputs define buses, lines, generators, converters, controls and disturbances; outputs include time trajectories, initial power flow, small-signal modes and CSV results. Supplied small and IEEE test systems have configurable duration, time steps and integration methods, with no fixed geographic coverage. Source is free under GPL-3.0, with command-line, Python and optional graphical interfaces. A limitation is the documented single-injector-per-node restriction caused by initialisation ambiguity; multi-injector modelling needs a network workaround. HERMESS can test electric-grid control and disturbance scenarios. ANDES (model-andes) offers related power-system dynamics software. The authors provide a versioned ETH software citation and distinguish this fork from its original estimator. No test system, model archive or environment was downloaded.
name: HERMESS hybrid EMT and RMS simulator
